summary: At a May 2026 state-superintendent forum, Barrera raised concerns about AB 715's classroom effects but said he would defend the law when it protects students, a conditional stance that neither rejects nor fully embraces the bill. CAIR Action lists him at the preferred tier in the general election, below full endorsement, and Vote for Peace rates him neutral. These signals together place his Palestine-policy position in the middle range.
